summary: Tested all 7 newly-created enhanced screens via mobile-viewport (390x844) Playwright runs against the Expo web preview. 6 of 7 routes render correctly with all expected testIDs visible and interactive flows working: settings-enhanced (4 toggles + connection status + clear cache + sign out all present), creators-enhanced (search filter 'dark' correctly narrows to @darkskully card), fans-enhanced (gracefully handles backend 401 from creatorsAPI without crashing, tab switching works), alerts-enhanced (unread badge=2, Mark All as Read clears badge, per-alert delete removes card), history-enhanced (creator filter chips correctly filter @darkskully sessions), fan-club-enhanced (renders correctly, smoke confirmed). CRITICAL: trends-enhanced HARD CRASHES inside the GodTierErrorBoundary because `VictoryTheme` is undefined in victory-native v41.20.2 - the v41 release dropped the legacy Victory wrapper API (VictoryChart/VictoryLine/VictoryTheme) in favor of the new Skia-based CartesianChart API. Also detected: minor issue where clicking the trash button on a creator card via Playwright did not remove the card (likely BlurView overlay swallowing the click on RN-Web, not a real-device blocker but worth investigating).

minor.issue: Returns 401 in the public preview. Screen handles it gracefully (no crash, just empty fan list) - not a regression from this batch, pre-existing known DB/auth issue.

ui_bugs.issue: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'material') at TrendsScreenContent. `VictoryTheme.material` is undefined because victory-native v41.20.2 removed the legacy Victory wrapper API. Screen falls through to GodTierErrorBoundary fallback. File: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/trends-enhanced.tsx:12,190

Clicking [data-testid='creators-delete-button-streamerqueen'] via Playwright (force=true) did not remove the card. Possibly BlurView/Image overlay intercepts touches on RN-Web. Logic in handleDeleteCreator looks correct (setCreators filter). Worth verifying on real device/Expo Go. File: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/creators-enhanced.tsx:239-245

integration_issues.issue: Backend returns 401 in preview, fans-enhanced shows empty/loading state without crashing (good defensive coding). No action needed for this batch.

react_native_issues.issue: Code uses legacy Victory API (VictoryChart, VictoryLine, VictoryTheme) but installed victory-native is v41.20.2 which only exports the new Skia-based CartesianChart/Line API. Either pin victory-native to ^40.x or rewrite to use CartesianChart/Line. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/trends-enhanced.tsx:12

rca_of_issue: victory-native v41.x (released 2024) is a complete rewrite using @shopify/react-native-skia and react-native-reanimated. It removed the legacy declarative components (VictoryChart, VictoryLine, VictoryArea, VictoryTheme, etc.) and exports only the new imperative-style components like CartesianChart, Line, Bar, Pie. The package.json pins ^41.20.2 but the code in trends-enhanced.tsx still imports VictoryChart/VictoryLine/VictoryTheme as if v40. At runtime, VictoryTheme is undefined → reading .material throws. Reproduction: navigate to /trends-enhanced → React error boundary catches `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'material')`. Mitigation: pick one of three remediation paths in action_items. Recommended: downgrade to victory-native@^40.0.0 if other batch-1 screens already use VictoryTheme (likely analytics-enhanced) to avoid widespread refactor.
